seed: THE CLAIM: where a layer sits and how big it is are on screen the moment you pick it, in any window this machine can open. On 2026-09-15 they were not. A piece of text picked in a three layer document asked the right hand panel for 1052 points; a laptop window gives it 688 and the largest window this display allows gives it 968, so the X, Y, width and height boxes were below the bottom edge at every size, and the plainest fact about a layer took a scroll to reach. The panel is over by a factor rather than by a few points, so the fix is not arithmetic: Position & Size now sits directly under the section named after the thing you picked, above Appearance and Effects. This walk builds the same document at three window sizes, picks the text, and waits for the panel's own frames to say Position & Size is wholly inside the viewport, so a failure here is a number and not an opinion. The last stage adds a second effect and opens it, which is the growth that used to push everything under it off the bottom, and asks again.

steps.comment: A laptop window, which is the size every claim about this panel is argued at.
THE TEST. Whole inside the panel's scrolling area, not merely a header showing at the bottom edge.
...and it did not cost the section named after what you clicked, nor the layers list you clicked in.

steps.note: text picked in a laptop window. Read dockSections and dockInView: Position & Size used to be 922-1052 in a 688 point panel.

steps.comment: A small window, where there is least room of all.

steps.note: the same in a 608 point panel, which is the tightest this is ever asked for.

steps.comment: And the largest window this display allows, where Appearance fits under it too.

steps.note: text picked in the largest window this display gives. Position & Size, the Text section and Appearance are all whole.

steps.comment: Now the growth that used to carry everything under it off the bottom: a second effect, opened. The plus is on the Effects header, which sits below Position & Size now, so a person scrolls to it.
Click the box and come back to the text, which is what a person does. The panel is built again from the top for each pick.
THE TEST for the second effect: two effects on the layer, one of them just opened, and none of the three sections above Effects has moved.

steps.note: a shadow and a border on the same piece of text, the border open. Effects is last, so what it does to its own height is its own business.
